tunables.label: JWT Secret
tunables.description: Signing key for login sessions, WebSocket handshakes and CSRF tokens; required in production.
tunables.troubleshooting: Without it auth routes return errors and logins/WebSockets are rejected. Use a long random value and never rotate it casually — existing sessions become invalid.

tunables.label: API Key Secret
tunables.description: Key-encryption secret for issued API keys; required in production.
tunables.troubleshooting: The app errors on startup/key use when unset. Keep it stable or previously issued API keys stop validating.

tunables.label: Initial Password
tunables.description: Bootstrap password for the first management user on a fresh data directory.
tunables.troubleshooting: Only applied while setup is incomplete; after onboarding it is ignored. The example is a local-only dummy value.

tunables.label: Data Directory
tunables.description: Persistent data directory (SQLite database, keys, uploads); must point at the mounted volume.
tunables.troubleshooting: Keep it on the declared /app/data volume, otherwise all state is lost when the container is recreated.

tunables.label: Server Port
tunables.description: Internal container listening port for the HTTP server; must match the published port target.
tunables.troubleshooting: If probes fail after changing this, update the compose mapping (for example 20129:20128) so both halves match.

tunables.label: Bind Address
tunables.description: Listen address for the HTTP server.
tunables.troubleshooting: Must be 0.0.0.0 inside a container; a loopback bind makes the published port unreachable.

tunables.label: Node Environment
tunables.description: Node.js execution mode; the image already defaults to production.
tunables.troubleshooting: Leave at production — development mode disables caching and shows verbose error output.

tunables.label: Memory Budget
tunables.description: OmniRoute's own memory budget in megabytes.
tunables.troubleshooting: Raise together with NODE_OPTIONS (--max-old-space-size) and the container memory limit if the process is OOM-killed.

tunables.label: Node Options
tunables.description: V8 heap limit passed to the Node.js runtime.
tunables.troubleshooting: Increase alongside OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB when large catalogs trigger heap OOM crashes.

tunables.label: Migrations Directory
tunables.description: Directory holding database migrations applied at startup.
tunables.troubleshooting: Only override when migrations are mounted elsewhere; a wrong path makes startup fail to apply schema updates.

notes: Health: GET / answers 307 (redirect to the dashboard) and GET /dashboard serves the UI; the image's own healthcheck script probes GET /healthz. GET / on the published host port doubles as the compose smoke test. Provider credentials are external requirements and are intentionally absent.
